text:
The diagram shows an electric heater being used to heat a beaker of water and an identical
beaker of oil for several minutes.
oil
water
electric heater
The temperature of the water and the temperature of the oil increase constantly. The rise in
temperature of the oil is much greater than that of the water.
Why is this?
A
The oil has a higher boiling point than water.
B
The oil has a higher thermal capacity than water.
C
The oil has a lower boiling point than water.
D
The oil has a lower thermal capacity than water.

options.label: A
options.text: The oil has a higher boiling point than water.

options.label: B
options.text: The oil has a higher thermal capacity than water.

options.label: C
options.text: The oil has a lower boiling point than water.

options.label: D
options.text: The oil has a lower thermal capacity than water.
